scope: Energy of the ideal constant-density inviscid potential exteriors in 3D and 4D, through quadratic weak lateral motion, including unsteady dipole pressure and finite-shell kinetic storage. Fixed mass throughput and far lab streams. No physical interface condition, conversion energy, inertia or isolated-pair energy supply is assigned.
review_status: Working, uncommitted pending independent review. Two CAS computations are not independent review legs.

construction_routes.sympy: Polar velocity components, moving-cut material transport and pressure work; radial integral of stored kinetic energy.
construction_routes.wolfram: Cartesian gradients and fixed-lab-time derivative of translated source/dipole potential; unsteady Bernoulli pressure; Green boundary identity for stored kinetic energy.

form_control: Omitting the time derivative from pressure while keeping evolving dipole storage produces a nonzero shell energy residual in both dimensions and both engines.
comparison: Author inspected the exact printed expressions after relabeling q, U/u, V/v, B/b, Bdot/bd, rho/density, R/outer and the joined-channel symbols. The energy flux, momentum flux, stored energy, remainder and equal-head diagnostic agree. Independent physical review remains pending.
